articles.title: Rebuilding Shopify's Finances summary from the Admin GraphQL API, line by line
articles.excerpt: In May 2025 Shopify's admin replaced the printed Financial Summary with an on-screen Finances summary. So I built a page that reproduces it from the Admin GraphQL API. Matching Shopify's figures turne…
articles.body: In May 2025 Shopify's admin replaced the printed Financial Summary with an on-screen Finances summary. So I built a page that reproduces it from the Admin GraphQL API. Matching Shopify's figures turned out to be mostly a question of definitions and dates, not arithmetic. Money and signs Every amount comes back as shopMoney.amount , a string. scalars/Decimal describes it as "A signed decimal number, which supports arbitrary precision and is serialized as a string." I never add those strings as floats. I parse each one into integer minor units, sum integers, and only format at the end. The precision comes from Intl : 2 for USD, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD. The second rule is about signs.

articles.body: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 1: Touch Grass What I Built TrailBird AI is a zero-latency, 100% offline open-source bird call identification system engineered specifically for deep wilderness trails where cell service is non-existent. When hiking in pine forests, river valleys, or mountain passes, proprietary cloud APIs fail instantly due to zero network connection. Furthermore, traditional nature apps often keep users staring at screens while scrolling through lists—defeating the entire purpose of being outdoors. TrailBird AI solves both problems: Zero Signal Independence: Operates entirely client-side on any smartphone browser (PWA) or laptop terminal with zero internet connection.

articles.title: TrailBird: Offline Bird Species Identification for the Trail
articles.excerpt: TrailBird: Offline Bird Species Identification for the Trail What I Built TrailBird is a lightweight, offline bird sound identification tool for hikers, birders, and anyone spending time outdoors. Whe…
articles.body: TrailBird: Offline Bird Species Identification for the Trail What I Built TrailBird is a lightweight, offline bird sound identification tool for hikers, birders, and anyone spending time outdoors. When I'm out on a trail and hear an unfamiliar call, I record the audio and pass it to TrailBird to get the species name, a model confidence score, and precise timestamps — completely offline. The project addresses a practical problem: the outdoors rarely come with reliable coverage. Instead of piping audio to a remote server, TrailBird packages an open-source acoustic model that downloads once (~540MB) and processes all inference locally on-device. No audio ever leaves the hardware, no network requests are made during inference, and identification happens right where you stand.

Game File's Stephen Totilo stated that Guillemot suggested that there are no Watch Dogs games in active development at the moment, which suggests Ubisoft may still be figuring out where to take the series from here.
